recent: A quiet guest-room dressing corner beside a large open window on a sunny morning — She checks the repaired hem of a short silk night robe on a wooden folding drying frame; the robe panel is lifted away by the frame as she unhooks it, revealing the already fully covering satin set underneath
A miniature-railway maintenance shed with its door open onto a sunny garden — She carefully straightens a bent brass rail joiner on a miniature track section laid on the workbench
a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table
a fashion runway under white spotlights — holds a rough white borax crystal flickering in both hands in front of her
a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — holds a cup in both hands
a kitchen or galley in her element's kingdom — standing
a hydrogen filling station at dusk — lying on her front

A mountain reservoir floating dock at the end of a supervised water-quality sampling session, empty around her — She peels back the loose shoulder panel of her open-sided sun-protection poncho to compare a small clear sample bottle against daylight before packing it away
a hilltop observatory with its dome open to a clear night sky — holds a book closed against her chest
an inn or tavern of her element's kingdom at night — seated on a chair
a training gym with a heavy bag — holds a small banded violet-and-green fluorite crystal glowing faintly in her palm at chest height
a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing
a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — swimming breaststroke
